content.text: [Feishu #sre-infra Bob Zhang Wed Jul 03 2024 09:00] Team: for the permanent fix, OpenSSH 9.8p1 introduces PerSourcePenalties and PerSourcePenaltyExemptList as new config options. We should document these in our post-remediation hardening guide.
Noted. PerSourcePenalties is a new defense-in-depth feature in 9.8p1 that rate-limits connections from individual source IPs. Will include in hardening docs.

[Feishu #sre-infra Dave Chen Wed Jul 03 2024 09:30] I found an old DRAFT workaround doc in our confluence: workaround_DRAFT_v0.md from June 2024 (before the CVE was public). It says to set LoginGraceTime 30. Should we update it?

That DRAFT document with LoginGraceTime 30 is deprecated and incorrect. The authoritative workaround is LoginGraceTime 0 (from oss-security/NVD), and even that is being reconsidered due to DoS risk. Do NOT reference the June DRAFT document — it should be marked as ARCHIVED.
